items.title: Snippet 1
The Long Way Home
items.description: A small song for the quiet road back.
items.text:
The sun took its time going down  
and the fields held on to the light  
I took the long way home again  
with your voice beside me all night.

items.title: A Letter for June
items.description: A note about ordinary days and keeping in touch.
items.text:
Dear June,

I hope this finds you well. The garden is getting on beautifully this year, and the evenings have been long enough for one more cup of tea on the porch.

Write when you can. There is always room for another story.

With love,

M.
